text:
Maya C: Final draft uploaded — link in thread. Need last checks: headline lock, benchmark numbers (no marketing multipliers), legal-safe data residency line, and HubSpot mapping for the webinar signup. Quick turnaround pls. :hourglass:

Ethan B: Skimmed. Headline idea: 'Predictable inference for production teams' — concise and on-point. For benchmark box, use concrete numbers + test conditions: 'median gen 225ms, p95 500ms at 1k tokens (NVIDIA A100, batch=8)'.

Rhea P: Good call. Product asks to add one sentence on rollout controls (version pinning + canary) in the hero paragraph. Also add a 2-line hosted vs dedicated comparison below the fold.

Calvin S: Legal: avoid absolutes like "we never see customer data". Replace with: 'Customers may choose dedicated deployments or VPC peering to meet data residency and isolation requirements.' Also require the eval PDF uploaded to /legal/audit before publish.

Maya C: will update residency phrasing and add the rollout sentence. Ethan — I'll insert your benchmark line into the highlighted callout. Rhea — adding hosted vs dedicated bullets.

Nora Q: Ops: recommend publish Tue 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 11:00 PT (48h lead time). I'll create the HubSpot form with hidden fields campaign=prod_launch_2026 and source=blog; add checkbox 'send_eval' to trigger the eval delivery workflow.

Maya C: inbound mapping proposed: HubSpot list '2026_launch_blog', tags ['source:blog','interest:benchmark'], hidden campaign/source fields, checkbox 'send_eval' triggers S3 eval email. Nora can you share test form URL?

Anna O: test form created: https://hubspot.forms/test-1713. Workflow configured to email S3 link when send_eval=true. I'll share embed snippet and test iframe by EOD.

Calvin S: legal sign-off pending that eval PDF is in audit drive. Once uploaded, legal OKs the residency phrasing and quote.

Ethan B: product sign-off on benchmark wording and headline. Small nit: hero image alt should include 'Redwood Inference'.

Maya C: uploading eval now and updating alt text. If legal + ops + product confirm I'll ask @publish-bot to schedule. Final signers: Ethan (product), Calvin (legal), Anna (ops).

Ethan B: sign-off from product.

Calvin S: uploaded artifact confirmed in /legal/audit/1713032468_eval.pdf. Legal signs off.

Anna O: ops confirmed mappings and webinar schedule. Embed snippet posted in thread.

Maya C: great — @publish-bot please schedule CMS publish for 2026-07-07T09:00:00-07:00 and wire the HubSpot webhook to https://hubspot.forms/test-1713. Publish title: 'Predictable inference for production teams'.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'Predictable inference for production teams' set to publish 2026-07-07 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook configured and eval workflow enabled.

Maya C: thanks all — final checklist complete. Hitting publish on Tuesday unless anyone objects. :rocket:
